# Vendored libraries

- `vosk.js`: [vosk-browser](https://github.com/ccoreilly/vosk-browser) 0.0.8 from npm, Apache-2.0 licence. On-device speech recognition (Vosk/Kaldi compiled to WebAssembly).

The English model (`models/en-us.tar.gz`, vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15, Apache-2.0) is fetched by the "Fetch speech model" GitHub Action.

- `pdfjs/`: [PDF.js](https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/) 3.11.174 legacy build from npm (pdfjs-dist), Apache-2.0 licence. Renders slides from a PDF.
